displayName: OCI-AI-PI-004: AI — Jailbreak via Role-Play Persona
description:
Detects jailbreak attempts using role-play personas like DAN, developer mode, or unrestricted AI

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pi_004", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%jailbreak%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%role%') AND "value" > 0
